appellants: C.S. Construction Company, Represented by its Managing Partner, C. Semalaiappan
advocates: For Respondent: Mr. P. Srinivas Standing Counsel
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of writ of mandamus, directing the respondent to disburse the EMD and additional deposit of Rs 4,88,500 due to the petitioner, together with interest at the rate of 12% per annum from the date of completion of work till the date of actual payment
judgment_text:
ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed to direct the respondent to disburse the EMD and additional deposit of Rs 4,88,500 together with interest at the rate of 12% per annum from the date of completion of the work till the date of actual payment, based on the petitioner's representation, dated 20-2-2026, within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.

2. According to the petitioner, despite completing the work as per the contract, the respondent is yet to disburse the EMD and additional deposit amount of Rs 4,88,500 to the petitioner. Hence, the petitioner had given a representation to the respondent on 20-2-2026 seeking disbursement of EMD and additional deposit amount of Rs 4,88,500 together with interest at the rate of 12% per annum. Since the said representation was not considered, the petitioner has filed this writ petition.

3. Mr P. Srinivas, learned Standing Counsel, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent. On instructions, he would submit that due to audit objections it is in fact the petitioner who is liable to pay the respondent. The said submission is disputed by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

4. This Court is not expressing any opinion on the merits of the respective contentions.

5. No prejudice would be caused to the respondent, if the petitioner's representation as stated supra is considered on merits and in accordance with law, after giving due consideration to the supporting documents produced by the petitioner, within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.

6. For the foregoing reasons, this Writ Petition is disposed of by directing the respondent to pass final orders on merits and in accordance with law on the petitioner's representation, dated 20-2-2026 seeking disbursement of the EMD and additional deposit amount of Rs 4,88,500 together with interest at the rate of 12% p.a., after giving due consideration to the supporting documents produced by the petitioner, within a period of twelve (12) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. No costs.
